title: Text Filtering and Pattern Matching (grep)
short_description: Filters file lines matching regular expression patterns or fixed strings using grep, egrep, or grep -E.
mental_triggers: Search for valid phone numbers in a text file
Filter log entries matching error codes
Invert match to exclude comments and empty lines with grep -v
constraint_signals: Line-based stream filtering with standard POSIX or extended regular expressions
complexity: Time: O(N * L) where N is line count, L is average line length | Space: O(L) stream buffer

dialect_notes.bash: LeetCode runs bash on Linux; GNU and BSD versions of sed, grep and sort differ (for example sed -i, grep -P).

base_template_sh:
# Read and filter lines matching a regex pattern
grep -P "^(\([0-9]{3}\) |[0-9]{3}-)[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{4}$" file.txt

title: Delimited Field Extraction and Transformation (awk / cut)
short_description: Parses delimited text files into columns, reformatting and extracting specific fields using awk or cut.
mental_triggers: Extract column 2 from space-separated or comma-separated log
Transpose or reorder fields in a structured report
Filter rows where column value satisfies numeric comparison (e.g. awk '$2 > 50')
constraint_signals: Structured columnar input where delimiter can be whitespace, tab, or custom character
complexity: Time: O(N * L) single-pass stream processing | Space: O(L) per-line buffer

dialect_notes.bash: LeetCode runs bash on Linux; GNU and BSD versions of sed, grep and sort differ (for example sed -i, grep -P).

title: Stream Editing and In-Place Substitution (sed)
short_description: Transforms text streams by performing regex substitutions, line insertions, deletions, or specific line extractions (sed).
mental_triggers: Print exactly the 10th line of a file (sed -n '10p')
Replace target keyword across text stream without loading whole file into memory
Delete trailing whitespace or leading comment blocks
constraint_signals: One-pass stream transformation with low memory overhead
complexity: Time: O(N * L) stream scan | Space: O(L) pattern buffer

dialect_notes.bash: LeetCode runs bash on Linux; GNU and BSD versions of sed, grep and sort differ (for example sed -i, grep -P).

base_template_sh:
# Extract Nth line directly without reading entire file
sed -n "10p" file.txt

title: Frequency Counting and Sorting (sort / uniq)
short_description: Counts item frequencies, removes adjacent duplicates, and orders output lines using the standard sort | uniq -c pipeline.
mental_triggers: Calculate word frequencies in a text file
Find top 10 most frequent IP addresses in web server access log
Sort words by descending frequency followed by alphabetical tie-breaker
constraint_signals: uniq requires sorted input to detect duplicate occurrences; sort -n for numeric, -r for reverse
complexity: Time: O(N log N) sorting + O(N) frequency aggregation | Space: O(N) temporary buffer

dialect_notes.bash: LeetCode runs bash on Linux; GNU and BSD versions of sed, grep and sort differ (for example sed -i, grep -P).

base_template_sh:
# Tokenize words, compute frequencies, and sort descending
cat words.txt | tr -s " " "
" | sort | uniq -c | sort -r | awk "{print \, \}"

title: Line-by-Line File Processing and State Tracking
short_description: Iterates through text streams line by line using bash while read loops or head/tail windowing, tracking state across lines.
mental_triggers: Read a file line-by-line preserving leading/trailing whitespace (IFS= read -r line)
Inspect fixed line windows (e.g. tail -n +10 | head -n 1)
Maintain stateful accumulators or multi-line state machines in bash
constraint_signals: Subshell variable scoping in pipelines; read loops must avoid pipeline subshell gotchas or use process substitution
complexity: Time: O(N * L) line-by-line evaluation | Space: O(L) single line variable

dialect_notes.bash: LeetCode runs bash on Linux; GNU and BSD versions of sed, grep and sort differ (for example sed -i, grep -P).

base_template_sh:
# Process file line-by-line preserving whitespace
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "" ]; do
    echo ""
done < file.txt
